ModMetaData.name: Connor's Localized Cleanliness!
ModMetaData.author: Kaan Connor Barmore-Genc
ModMetaData.description:
Food poisoning from cooking, surgery success, and post-tend infection depend on the cleanliness of the immediate area around where the work happens, not the average over the whole room.
This fixes two problems with vanilla. Vanilla averages cleanliness over the entire room, so small rooms are penalized while large ones shrug off dirt, and outdoors it does not measure cleanliness at all. Because this mod checks only the surrounding area, room size stops mattering and the calculation works outdoors too.
Radius, falloff, and per-system toggles are in mod settings. Requires Harmony.
